static_traits.name: Zhou Baolin
static_traits.social_status: 与其他Photographer和客户的关系因Self-doubt和缺乏自信而紧张;有少数Photographer朋友可交谈,但难以敞露自己的not安与Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史;既往not yet接受心理治疗;not yet出现类似问题的既往史
static_traits.language_features: Tone is negative; can clearly express experiences and feelings; has repetitive negative self-talk; skeptical about change but willing to try; cooperation acceptable

basic_info.main_problem: 今天not小心摔坏了相机镜头后,我觉得自己是一个糟糕的Photographer,引发强烈的without能感和Self-doubt.这些感受在摄影出现挫折或犯错时都会出现,并逐渐加重,影响了我拍摄的动机与对摄影的享受.
basic_info.core_demands: 'This camera incident made me realize the extent of my negative self-talk and how it affects my passion and livelihood, prompting me to seek counseling.'; 'I am just tired of always feeling this way.'

special_situations.event: 今天not小心摔坏了相机镜头
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯错,就证明I am not competent enough,是个糟糕的Photographer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to rationalize and focus on the positive aspects of the work, but negative feelings still prevail
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我是一个糟糕的Photographer,我太粗心了

special_situations.event: Whenever encountering setbacks or mistakes in photography
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 每一次挫折都在证明我not适合这行,永远not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复自我批评,拍摄Decreased motivation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 每次挫折都证明我not适合摄影

special_situations.event: 与其他Photographer和客户的互动与合作
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Relationship tension是因为I am not good enough,这说明我有问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避向朋友敞露not安,减少求助与交流
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 都是因为I am not good enough,才让关系变差

special_situations.event: Reviews own work and tries to attend to positive performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 积极经历not重要,错误才最能说明问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to record/recall good photography experiences (e.g. client praise last month), but finds it hard to maintain positive feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 好的都not算数,今天的错误才说明我not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized through photography, maintain a sense of competence and self-worth (photography is the core of self-identity)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕犯错与失败会证明自己without能,失去自我认同与生计
defense_goal: 通过严苛的自我批评与回避敞露not安来维持控制感,减少被评判的风险

object_relations.object_representation: Others (clients/colleagues) may be picky evaluators who will be disappointed or critical

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor challenges and restructures negative beliefs and suggests recording positive experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些方法对自己作用有限,自己的消极想法'根深蒂固',改变not太可能
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 承认其怀疑感受,以支持性,具体化的QuestioningGuidance其回到实际体验;语气温和,not评判,邀请其尝试小步验证与检视证据.

manifestations: 将摄影视为自我与生命意义的重要组成;一旦失败(如摔坏镜头)便感到'完全without用'
Enjoyment and passion for photography decline; hard to stay connected to positive experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁自我批评(如'我是绝对的失败者/not够好')

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally meant to be directed outward onto themselves, changing what they wanted to do to others or the environment into doing it to themselves.
manifestations: 难以向朋友求助或表达not安,转而自责和攻击自己
After making a mistake, turns anger/disappointment into self-punishing negative self-talk

exception_events.target_problem: 在遇到摄影挫折或错误时,来访者通常会陷入强烈的消极自我对话与Self-doubt,Decreased motivation,影响拍摄与收入.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上个月的一次拍摄一切顺利,客户十分满意并推荐她给朋友,她对此感到Good.
exception_events.reason: 线索:not同支持与情境——拍摄流程顺利,客户给予积极反馈与推荐;not同体验——成功经历短暂提升了自信与连结感.

positive_force: Full of passion for photography (photography is the passion and main income source)
Has experience of successful works and client recommendations (filmed last month)
negative_force: 消极自我对话强烈,遇到错误即Self-denial
Has cognitive distortions such as black-and-white thinking and mental filtering
难以向Social support系统敞露not安,Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: 反复的消极自我对话(如'我是一个糟糕的Photographer')
antecedent: Encountering setbacks or making mistakes in photography
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与职业表现过度绑定,对错误采取非黑即白/灾难化的Interpretation,Reinforcementwithout能感
target_behavior.function: Self-punishes and tries to gain a sense of control through self-blame, while avoiding directly facing the emotions brought by failure
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与Intensifying self-doubt,拍摄Decreased motivation,职业表现与收入受损

antecedent: When a mistake happens or one thinks of erring again
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心失败会证明自己not适合摄影,回避羞耻与Anxiety体验
target_behavior.function: Avoiding negative evaluation and potential failure
target_behavior.consequence: without法稳定Work与收入,错失机会,Career development受阻

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交互动中回避向朋友/同行敞露not安
antecedent: 与Photographer朋友或客户交流时涉及自身not安与自信问题的情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕暴露脆弱会被看轻或拒绝,将Interpersonal tension归因于自身not够好
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged, maintains surface control and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support,Relationship tension加重Loneliness感,进一步维持负面情绪与认知循环
